description: Delete an agent inbox. Mail to the address is refused from then on, and the mail the inbox stored is deleted with it: this can't be undone. The answer has `heldUntil`: until then no other workspace can take the address. It is 90 days after the delete, and null for an address on a domain of ours, which is held for good. You can make the address again yourself at any time. Deleting frees the inbox's place under the plan and the storage its mail used. An inbox in another workspace, or one already deleted, answers 404.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.
